channel.title: Kim Phong
channel.description: Notes on Flutter, iOS, and the tooling around shipping mobile apps.

item.title: Never bigger than a Pro Max: fitting an iPhone-only Flutter app onto the iPhone Duo
item.description: Our Flutter app is iPhone-only and portrait-only. Instead of designing tablet layouts for the iPhone Duo, we cap its scale at an iPhone Pro Max, bound it by height, and hunt down everything that cached a size.
